name: Rise of the Penguins GB
blurb: Rise of the Penguins is a 2D side-scrolling action-platformer for Gameboy.
description:
Rise of the Penguins is a 2D side-scrolling action-platformer for Gameboy.
The game is meant to be simple and linear but with some challenging enemies.
Inspired by Ghost n Goblins and a bit of Mega Man.

Features:

• 6 levels with a variety of enemies in each level

• 2 extra levels

• Boss Rush Mode - unlocked after beating all 6 levels

• 6 mini boss enemies and 8 boss enemies plus a final boss

• 6 difficulty settings to adjust checkpoints

• Basic HUD showing highscore, health and time remaining

• Minimal story with no text - engaging gameplay keeps you playing
